decode_bytes_to_string: decode space-separated byte characters back into the original string using the Bytes decoder
register_bytes_bpe: register the Bytes class as a BPE encoder with the name bytes in fairseq
review_bytes_encode: review the Bytes encode method that normalizes whitespace and converts UTF-8 bytes to bchar representations
review_bytes_decode: review the Bytes decode method that unescapes space characters and uses smart_byte_decode for recovery
